feature_set_descriptions.wav2vec2_only: Wav2Vec2 posterior distribution plus confidence summaries only.
feature_set_descriptions.no_sa: All non-SA cues: Wav2Vec2 posterior, confidence summaries, energy ratio, and WavLM presence score.
feature_set_descriptions.with_sa: Full cue set: Wav2Vec2 posterior, confidence summaries, energy ratio, WavLM presence score, and Speech Attribute probabilities.

evaluation_mode_descriptions.strict_all: Evaluate every aligned phone segment; this is the strict reference score.
evaluation_mode_descriptions.consonant_only: Evaluate consonant segments only, excluding vowels, schwa, and r-colored vowel cases.

leakage_rules: No speaker may appear in train, validation, and test within the same run.
Thresholds, feature choices, prompt variants, and ablations are selected using train/validation only.
The Vietnamese test speaker is evaluated once for final reporting.
Feature extraction may run on test audio only when it is deterministic and label-free.
Human labels from test must never be used for model selection.
